source_pr_title: Force useTls=true in web UI patch — OpenShift Route always terminates TLS
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Logic Error**: Hardcoding `useTls = true` breaks compatibility with non-OpenShift environments and local development. If deployed without TLS termination, browsers will attempt ` connections that fail on plain HTTP servers, causing connection failures. Consider detecting the protocol from `X-Forwarded-Proto` header with a fallback to `true`, or make this configurable via environment variable to support different deployment scenarios.
```suggestion
    const useTls = req.headers['x-forwarded-proto'] === 'https' || process.env.FORCE_TLS === 'true';
```
